page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM hypervisor. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. Accompanying the core count is 256.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 2.0 GB of memory per vCPU core.

The instance does not feature bundled local SSD storage or discrete GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached block storage for system and data volumes. Network performance is backed by a 64 Gbps baseline bandwidth capacity, enabling fast data transfer and high throughput for network-bound communication.

Given its compute-heavy resource ratio and 128 dedicated vCPUs, ecs.c7.32xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale compute workloads, continuous integration pipelines, batch processing, video encoding, and high-concurrency microservices requiring substantial CPU throughput without large memory overhead per core.
